prompt: Most healthy leaves look green, even though sunlight contains all the colours of the rainbow. Why green?

options.text: Leaves contain a green dye that they make from minerals drawn up from the soil
Leaves absorb green light most strongly, and we see the colour a leaf absorbs most
Tiny green insects and algae living on the leaf surface give it its colour
The pigment chlorophyll absorbs mainly blue and red light for photosynthesis and reflects green light, which is what reaches our eyes

explanation: Chlorophyll absorbs mainly blue and red light for photosynthesis and reflects much of the green light that falls on it. It is that reflected green light reaching your eyes that makes most healthy leaves look green.
